item.title: Iranian president, FM reemerge in public despite Netanyahu’s threatened '10 plagues' of war
item.description: Senior Iranian leaders appeared at pro-regime rallies in Tehran after weeks out of public view, signaling defiance despite Israeli claims of targeting top officials; Araghchi: 'There are no negotiations, there is an exchange of messages. We will not accept a ceasefire'

item.title: Israel pushes US to hit Iran energy sites, says it could collapse regime
item.description: Officials in Jerusalem said a target bank focused on energy facilities and critical infrastructure has already been prepared, with any potential strike now dependent on a decision by Trump

item.title: Netanyahu: Iran no longer poses an existential threat to Israel
item.description: PM claims Iran had invested nearly $1 trillion in its military buildup, including nuclear and missile programs, and now he says that investment has now been 'wasted'

item.title: Israel says it has completed strikes on vital targets in Iran
item.description: IDF says Air Force had put nearly all predesignated 'vital and strategic' targets out of operation, including military-industrial and nuclear-related sites, while pressing attacks in Tehran and opening a new ground line in southern Lebanon

item.title: IDF strike in Beirut kills Hezbollah Southern Front commander
item.description: Military says Hajj Yusuf Ismail Hashem oversaw Hezbollah operations in southern Lebanon, including rocket fire and aerial attacks toward Israel, as well as plans targeting civilians and soldiers
